answer_1.quote: We evaluate MExGen on two text generation tasks, summarization and context-grounded QA.

answer_2.quote: We measure local fidelity of explanations using perturbation curves... plotting the resulting change in some output scalarization measuring how much the perturbed output deviates from the target output.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a user study to understand how humans perceive explanations provided by different scalarizers and attribution methods... We recruited participants... and collected data from 88 of them after filtering.
answer_4.guideline: Participants compared explanations pairwise and answered questions on fidelity and preference of attribution methods.
